y-m-24-03.s.s1.r.a: Kharashka qaangaarka waxaa loo qoray 3 ee 3000 won halka wadartu ku qoran tahay won sida ay tahay, sidaas darteed cutubyo ayaa isku qasan hal isla'eg dhexdiisa.
y-m-24-03.s.s1.r.b: Tani waa fikirka aqoonsaday in qadar kasta lagu qoray cutubyada kun won.
y-m-24-03.s.s1.r.c: Qadar kasta waxaa lagu qoray cutubyada won, qiimayaashana waa la isku dhuftay si ay ugu habboonaadaan macnaha x iyo y.
y-m-24-03.s.s1.r.d: Kharashyada qaangaarka iyo caruurta waa la beddelay. Dib uma eegin waxa x ka dhigan yahay.
y-m-24-03.s.s1.explain: 가 iyo 다 waxay u qoraan isla xaalad cutubyo kala duwan. Xallinta 가 waxay siinaysaa x=4, y=6, xallinta 다 na waxay siinaysaa isla jawaab. In 나, 3 iyo 2 ee 3x+2y waa cutubyada kun won laakiin 24000 waa cutubyada won, sidaas darteed ma habboona, in 라 na kharashyada qaangaarka iyo caruurta waa la beddelay sidaas darteed x=6, y=4 ayaa soo baxaya, tirada qaangaarka iyo caruurtuna way is rogtay.
y-m-24-03.s.s1.acc.0: 가 waa sax. Hubi haddii 다 sidoo kale tahay isla'eg u qorta isla xaalad cutubyada kun won. Xitaa haddii cutubyadu u muuqdaan kuwo kala duwan, waxay qeexi karaan isla xaalad.
y-m-24-03.s.s2.prompt: Qor hab lagu muujiyo, adigoon xallinin isla'egyada isku-xigta, in isla'egta labaad ee 나, 3x+2y=24000, aysan ku habboonayn xaaladdan.
y-m-24-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir qiimaha ugu weyn ee dhinaca bidix ee isla'egta labaad ee 나 qaadan karo, marka la siiyo x+y=10.
y-m-24-03.s.s2.hint.1: Barbar dhig cutubka ay ku jiraan lambarrada 3, 2, iyo 24000 mid kasta.
y-m-24-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma qortay ugu yaraan hal sabab oo muujinaysa isla'egta inay khaldan tahay adigoon xallinin?
y-m-24-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegi kartaa haddii sababta aad qortay ay ku saabsan tahay 'cutubyada' ama 'cabbirka'?
y-m-24-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma ka fikirtay sidoo kale sida dib loogu qori karo, sida 가 ama 다?
y-m-24-03.s.s2.model.0: Haddii x+y=10, markaas x iyo y labaduba waa 10 ama ka yar, sidaas darteed 3x+2y waa ugu badnaan 30. Laakiin ma noqon karto 24000, sidaas darteed 나 ma ku habboona xaaladdan.
y-m-24-03.s.s2.model.1: In 3x, 3 waa cutubyada kun won laakiin 24000 waa cutubyada won, sidaas darteed cutubyadu way kala duwan yihiin. Haddii aad qorto 3000x+2000y=24000 ama aad 24000 u beddesho 24, waxay noqonaysaa isla'eg sax ah.
y-m-24-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Waxay isticmaashay cutubyada sida sabab oo xitaa waxay qortay sida loo hagaajiyo.

y-m-24-06.title: Wadarta afar labajibbaar ee kalandarka: intee ayay bayaanka Jiyun sax tahay?
y-m-24-06.topic: Odhaahyo leh xarfo: sharaxaadda wadarta tirooyinka kalandarka
y-m-24-06.goal: Hagaaji xeer laga dhisay dhowr tusaale adigoo isticmaalaya xog cusub, dhig odhaah leh xarfo si aad u hubiso shuruudda xeerku ku shaqeeyo, ka dibna samee tusaalayaal shuruud kale si isku mid ah.
y-m-24-06.material: Kalandarku wuxuu leeyahay 7 labajibbaar saf ah (Axad ilaa Sabti), bishani waxay leedahay 31 maalmood, 1da na waa Axad. Sidaas darteed 1da ilaa 7da waa safka koowaad iyo 8da ilaa 14ka waa safka labaad. Haddii aad doorato qaybta 2×2 ee labajibbaar (2 labajibbaar ka hor iyo 2 labajibbaar hoos) kalandarkan, waxaad heleysaa afar lambar. Jiyun wuxuu yiri, "Haddii aad ku darto afarta lambar ee qaybta 2×2, mar walba waa isku-dhufte 8!"

y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Waxaad saddex hubin u beddeshay 'had iyo jeer'. Ma eegin nooca boosaska la tijaabiyey.
y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Waxay u egtahay sax, laakiin saddex boos oo keliya ayaa la tijaabiyey, sidaa darteed waa goor hore in laga hubo

y-m-24-06.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 20 iyo 28 ma aha jibbaar 8, sidaa darteed 'had iyo jeer jibbaar 8' ma run aha
